text:
maria: Heads-up: NovusPay (EU fintech) wants a 60-day pilot that allows per-region burst but with a hard cap per-region and detailed audit logs/KMS integration. They say regulatory review needs it for PSD2 compliance.

tom: Do they want different caps per region or a global pool with regional enforcement?

maria: Different caps. Example: EU region cap = 1.5x committed slab, APAC = 1.2x, US = no burst. Also require per-request provenance logs and KMS-wrapped keys for any persisted data.

jess: That last bit triggers Private deployment requirements. KMS and audit trails are heavy. Can we scope to hosted API with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key)?

legal-bot: For regulated pilots: include a clause that limits liability, requires customer to provide their regulator contact details, and obligates them to pause pilot if regulator requests. Also record-retention policy needs to be explicit.

finance-lee: Need quick cost model: regional burst changes capacity placement and potential cross-region egress. Rough ballpark: EU burst at 1.5x for 60d could add $8-12k in variable infra cost depending on traffic shape.

eng-omar: Tech notes: Enforcement requires per-region quotas + billing tags; meter + console changes ~2 dev-days. BYOK KMS integration + audit log ingestion ~2-3 sprints depending on compliance checks.

jess: Could we offer a constrained MVP: enforce soft regional caps (alerts + manual throttle by ops) and collect provenance logs for a subset of requests? That avoids immediate BYOK work.

maria: Customer insists on KMS from the start. Sales says it's gating.

sales-claire: NovusPay has legal review starting next week. We need an internal decision by EOD tomorrow whether to accept pilot shape or push BYOK to stretch.

maria: Proposed launch plan: MVP (ship in 2 weeks) = regional softcaps + alerting + limited audit logging (sampled); Stretch (post-pilot) = hard regional caps + full BYOK + full retention. Gate to GA: regulator sign-off + audit by internal compliance team + no P1 incidents.

legal-bot: Also require customer to sign a pilot data handling addendum covering log access, retention period, and deletion requests.

finance-lee: I'll assemble a 60-day P&L and note potential egress charges by region.

eng-omar: I'll scope BYOK integration and audit pipeline; can do a spike tomorrow. If Sales pushes hard, we need to prioritize.

maria: Actions: Tom to confirm per-region caps with NovusPay; Eng-Omar spike BYOK + logging; Legal draft pilot addendum; Finance run P&L; Sales-Claire confirm regulator timeline. Back here tomorrow. :calendar:
